about: CDOS computer SAMPLER data: the 64 hexagrams of the I Ching. Numbers, names and trigram structure are the traditional King Wen sequence. The counsel and sayings are original paraphrases, not quotations from any translation. Edit them freely. This output is random and is never used as evidence.

lines.1: at the very beginning, where things are still small
lines.2: in the quiet center of your own heart
lines.3: at the crossing point, where it is easy to stumble
lines.4: at the threshold, close to something larger
lines.5: at the heart of the matter, where you have the most say
lines.6: at the far edge, where a thing has gone as far as it can

hexagrams.name: The Creative
hexagrams.counsel: Your strength is real, so use it steadily, like the sky that never stops turning.
sayings: Strength that keeps going is greater than strength that bursts.
Begin with heart, continue with patience.

hexagrams.name: The Receptive
hexagrams.counsel: Follow rather than lead for now; good ground grows everything planted in it.
sayings: The field does not hurry, and still the harvest comes.
Listening is a kind of strength.

hexagrams.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
hexagrams.counsel: Beginnings are tangled; ask for help and sort one thread at a time.
sayings: Every sprout must push through hard soil.
Confusion at the start is the sound of something new.

hexagrams.name: Youthful Folly
hexagrams.counsel: Ask a real question once and truly listen to the answer; that is how learning starts.
sayings: Not knowing is the doorway, not the wall.
A student who asks well is already halfway wise.

hexagrams.name: Waiting
hexagrams.counsel: The rain is coming; eat, rest and stay ready instead of forcing the clouds.
sayings: Waiting well is not doing nothing.
A sensor does not chase the dawn; it waits for it.

hexagrams.name: Conflict
hexagrams.counsel: Winning the argument may cost more than it gives; meet halfway or ask a fair third person.
sayings: Two stubborn goats on a narrow bridge both get wet.
Stop before the quarrel grows teeth.

hexagrams.name: The Army
hexagrams.counsel: Organize what you have and follow one clear purpose; scattered effort wins nothing.
sayings: Many hands need one direction.
Order is a quiet kind of courage.

hexagrams.name: Holding Together
hexagrams.counsel: Find your people and stay close to them; together you are harder to blow away.
sayings: One twig snaps; a bundle holds.
Belonging is built by showing up.

hexagrams.name: Small Taming
hexagrams.counsel: Small, gentle steps will do more right now than one big push.
sayings: Clouds gather long before the rain.
A little care each day tames a big wild thing.

hexagrams.name: Treading
hexagrams.counsel: Walk carefully and politely, even near something fierce, and you will pass safely.
sayings: Good manners are a lantern in the dark.
Step lightly near the tiger's tail.

hexagrams.name: Peace
hexagrams.counsel: Things fit together now; enjoy it, share it and tend it so it lasts.
sayings: When heaven and earth meet, everything grows.
Good times are for planting, too.

hexagrams.name: Standstill
hexagrams.counsel: The way is blocked for a while; keep your values and wait for the season to turn.
sayings: Even a closed door is part of the house.
Winter is not the end of the tree.

hexagrams.name: Fellowship
hexagrams.counsel: Work openly with others toward something you all care about.
sayings: A shared fire warms everyone.
Friends are found in the open, not in corners.

hexagrams.name: Great Possession
hexagrams.counsel: You have plenty right now; be generous and modest with it, and it stays.
sayings: A full basket is a chance to share.
The sun gives light without keeping score.

hexagrams.name: Modesty
hexagrams.counsel: Be humble and fair; the quiet one who levels the ground is remembered kindly.
sayings: The mountain hides inside the earth and loses nothing.
Humility makes room for others to grow.

hexagrams.name: Enthusiasm
hexagrams.counsel: Your excitement can lift others; aim it at something worth the energy.
sayings: Thunder wakes the sleeping earth.
Joy is contagious; choose what you spread.

hexagrams.name: Following
hexagrams.counsel: Go with the good current and rest when it is time to rest.
sayings: The wise follow what is right, not what is loud.
Even thunder sleeps in winter.

hexagrams.name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
hexagrams.counsel: Something old needs fixing; find where it went wrong and mend it with care.
sayings: What is neglected does not stay still.
Mending is a kind of making.

hexagrams.name: Approach
hexagrams.counsel: Good things are coming closer; meet them warmly, but remember seasons change.
sayings: Spring comes one warm day at a time.
Approach with kindness and doors open.

hexagrams.name: Contemplation
hexagrams.counsel: Climb up high and look at the whole picture before you decide.
sayings: A sensor reads best when it is still.
Look at yourself as kindly as you look at the stars.

hexagrams.name: Biting Through
hexagrams.counsel: Something is in the way; name it clearly and deal with it fairly.
sayings: A problem chewed is a problem solved.
Clear words cut through fog.

hexagrams.name: Grace
hexagrams.counsel: Make things beautiful, but remember the beauty is in what is real underneath.
sayings: A pretty shell is still a shell.
Kindness is the best decoration.

hexagrams.name: Splitting Apart
hexagrams.counsel: Things are falling away; do not fight it, keep what is solid and let the rest go.
sayings: When leaves fall, the roots remember.
Let go of what is already leaving.

hexagrams.name: Return
hexagrams.counsel: The light is coming back; take one small step in the right direction.
sayings: After the longest night, the day grows.
Turning around is also moving forward.

hexagrams.name: Innocence
hexagrams.counsel: Act honestly without scheming, and things go well; tricks spoil it.
sayings: The simple heart walks the straightest path.
Do the right thing for its own sake.

hexagrams.name: Great Taming
hexagrams.counsel: Store up your strength and learn from what came before; your time to act will come.
sayings: A mountain holds the whole sky's strength inside.
Learn, keep, and then give.

hexagrams.name: Nourishment
hexagrams.counsel: Pay attention to what you feed your body, your mind and your friends.
sayings: You become what you take in.
Careful words are good food for others.

hexagrams.name: Great Exceeding
hexagrams.counsel: The load is heavier than the beam; lighten it or move, gently and soon.
sayings: A branch heavy with snow bends before it breaks.
Too much of anything asks for a change.

hexagrams.name: The Abysmal
hexagrams.counsel: It is a hard place, but water keeps flowing and finds the way out; keep your heart steady.
sayings: Water never gives up on the sea.
Be truthful inside, and the danger cannot drown you.

hexagrams.name: The Clinging
hexagrams.counsel: Hold on to what makes you bright, and let your light help others see.
sayings: Fire needs wood; brightness needs something to hold.
Clarity is a gift you can share.

hexagrams.name: Influence
hexagrams.counsel: Be open and sincere; people are moved by a gentle heart more than by pushing.
sayings: The lake on the mountain reflects the sky.
To be heard, first be open.

hexagrams.name: Duration
hexagrams.counsel: Keep doing the good thing you are doing; steadiness is its own magic.
sayings: The river shapes the stone by staying.
Little and often beats much and once.

hexagrams.name: Retreat
hexagrams.counsel: Step back calmly; leaving at the right time is wisdom, not defeat.
sayings: The mountain does not chase the sky.
Stepping back gives room to see.

hexagrams.name: Great Power
hexagrams.counsel: You are strong right now; use it fairly, because strength without kindness breaks things.
sayings: Thunder in the sky is loud; let your goodness be louder.
Power is best when it is gentle.

hexagrams.name: Progress
hexagrams.counsel: Things are rising like the morning sun; keep shining honestly.
sayings: The sun rises without pushing anyone.
Steady light gets noticed.

hexagrams.name: Darkening of the Light
hexagrams.counsel: It is a dim time; keep your light safe inside and be patient with the dark.
sayings: Even hidden, a lamp is still a lamp.
Every night cycle ends.

hexagrams.name: The Family
hexagrams.counsel: Look after home and the people in it; good things grow outward from there.
sayings: Kind words at home travel far.
Every nest is built twig by twig.

hexagrams.name: Opposition
hexagrams.counsel: You see things differently, and that is all right; agree on small things first.
sayings: Fire rises, the lake sinks, and both are good.
Different is not the same as wrong.

hexagrams.name: Obstruction
hexagrams.counsel: A mountain is in the way; go around, ask for help, and look at yourself honestly.
sayings: The stuck path teaches a new one.
When blocked, turn and grow.

hexagrams.name: Deliverance
hexagrams.counsel: The knot is coming loose; forgive, tidy up quickly, and move on lightly.
sayings: After the storm, the air is clean.
Forgiving is how the knot comes undone.

hexagrams.name: Decrease
hexagrams.counsel: Less can be better; give up what is extra and keep what is true.
sayings: A simple bowl, offered sincerely, is enough.
Lighter wings fly farther.

hexagrams.name: Increase
hexagrams.counsel: A time of growing; help others and you will both grow.
sayings: Wind and thunder make each other stronger.
What you give to others grows in you.

hexagrams.name: Breakthrough
hexagrams.counsel: Say the true thing out loud, kindly and firmly, without anger.
sayings: The dam bursts best when the water is clear.
Speak truth without a sword.

hexagrams.name: Coming to Meet
hexagrams.counsel: Something new is arriving; welcome it carefully before you let it take over.
sayings: Not every visitor should move in.
Meet the new with open eyes.

hexagrams.name: Gathering Together
hexagrams.counsel: People are coming together; share a common purpose and be ready for surprises.
sayings: Many streams make a lake.
A gathering needs a center.

hexagrams.name: Pushing Upward
hexagrams.counsel: Grow upward a little each day, like a tree; effort adds up.
sayings: The tallest tree began as a seed in the dark.
Climb one branch at a time.

hexagrams.name: Oppression
hexagrams.counsel: You are tired and words are not helping; rest, stay true, and let actions speak.
sayings: A dry lake still remembers rain.
When words fail, kindness still works.

hexagrams.name: The Well
hexagrams.counsel: Go back to the deep source that always helps you, and keep the rope in good repair.
sayings: The town moves, but the well stays.
Draw from deep water, not from puddles.

hexagrams.name: Revolution
hexagrams.counsel: It is time for a real change; choose the right moment and make it clear why.
sayings: The snake sheds its skin to grow.
Change done at the right time feels like spring.

hexagrams.name: The Cauldron
hexagrams.counsel: Slowly cook good ideas into something nourishing to share.
sayings: Good soup takes time and fire.
What you prepare with care, feeds many.

hexagrams.name: The Arousing
hexagrams.counsel: A loud surprise! Take a breath, check yourself, then laugh and carry on.
sayings: Thunder scares, then the rain feeds the fields.
A shock can wake you up kindly.

hexagrams.name: Keeping Still
hexagrams.counsel: Be still and quiet for a while; the restless mind settles like snow in a globe.
sayings: The mountain answers everything by staying.
Stillness is where clear thoughts land.

hexagrams.name: Development
hexagrams.counsel: Grow slowly, step by step, like a tree on a mountain; no need to rush.
sayings: The wild goose lands one shore at a time.
Slow roots hold the strongest trees.

hexagrams.name: The Marrying Maiden
hexagrams.counsel: You are not in charge of this one; be tactful and do your part well.
sayings: Know your place in the dance, and dance it well.
Patience is the best manners.

hexagrams.name: Abundance
hexagrams.counsel: This is a bright, full moment; enjoy it now without worrying about tomorrow.
sayings: Be like the sun at noon, and do not mourn the evening.
Full moments are for living, not counting.

hexagrams.name: The Wanderer
hexagrams.counsel: You are in an unfamiliar place; be polite, careful and curious, and you will be fine.
sayings: The traveler packs light and listens well.
A guest who is kind finds every door.

hexagrams.name: The Gentle
hexagrams.counsel: Be gentle and keep at it, like the wind that slowly shapes the hills.
sayings: Soft wind, steady breath, mountains change.
Gentle and steady goes everywhere.

hexagrams.name: The Joyous
hexagrams.counsel: Share joy and talk with friends; real happiness is honest happiness.
sayings: Two lakes keep each other full.
Laughter shared is laughter doubled.

hexagrams.name: Dispersion
hexagrams.counsel: Let hard feelings melt away like ice in spring wind, and come back together.
sayings: The wind scatters the clouds and the sky is clear.
Let the cold thing melt.

hexagrams.name: Limitation
hexagrams.counsel: Good limits help, like banks that keep a river flowing; just do not make them too tight.
sayings: A bamboo is strong because of its joints.
Enough is a beautiful word.

hexagrams.name: Inner Truth
hexagrams.counsel: Be truly honest with yourself and others; even shy creatures trust a sincere heart.
sayings: An empty heart has room for truth.
Sincerity reaches further than shouting.

hexagrams.name: Small Exceeding
hexagrams.counsel: Do the small things well now; this is not the time to fly too high.
sayings: The little bird should stay near the ground in a storm.
Small and careful is right today.

hexagrams.name: After Completion
hexagrams.counsel: Things are finished and in order; stay careful so they do not slide back into mess.
sayings: When the work is done, keep watch.
Order is kept, not just made.

hexagrams.name: Before Completion
hexagrams.counsel: You are almost across the river; go carefully to the very end.
sayings: The little fox crosses the ice with care.
Almost done is still a journey.
